content: We also implement the bias regularization method of BIBREF5 which debiases the word embedding during language model training by minimizing the projection of neutral words on the gender axis. We use hyperparameter tuning to find the best regularization coefficient and report results from the model trained with this coefficient. We later refer to this strategy as REG.
